newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine consumer prices drop 0.1 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Argentine consumer prices drop 0.1 pct in May.

text.p: Argentina's consumer price index fell 0.1 percent in May versus 0.1 percent deflation in May last year and 0.3 percent deflation in April this year, officials said Tuesday.
Wholesale prices rose 0.7 percent in May, compared to 0.2 percent wholesale inflation in May last year and 0.4 percent wholesale deflation in April this year.
Annualized consumer inflation in May was 0.7 percent while wholesale prices over the last 12 months were down 0.4 percent.
The construction price indicator showed an increase for May of 0.3 percent compared with zero in May 1996 and in April this year.
